text: ὁ Πάνδα καὶ ὁ Διναύσαρος βάλλουσι τὴν ἐρυθρὰν σφαῖραν παρὰ τὴν ἀγοράν.
objects: a bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Panda stands on the left throwing the ball with both hands toward Dinosaur
Dinosaur stands on the right with arms outstretched ready to catch the ball
The bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit flies through the air between them
